rationale_letter: Re: Audit of per-diem revenue line (0192) - Claim MR_SNF_04 We reviewed the medical record for the above claim and audited the documentation supporting the billed Level 2 Rehab Therapy per-diem (revenue code 0192) for DOS range 2026-04-15 through 2026-04-24 (7 days billed). Our review found that therapy-session minutes are documented on 2026-04-15, 2026-04-16, 2026-04-17 and 2026-04-20 through 2026-04-24, but there is no therapy-session documentation for 2026-04-18 or 2026-04-19. Basis for finding: the facility's therapy flow-sheet entries document 60 minutes of Physical Therapy and 45 minutes of Occupational Therapy on dates such as 2026-04-17 ("{\"service_date\": \"2026-04-17\", \"note_title\": \"Physical Therapy\", \"revenue_code\": \"0421\", \"minutes\": 60, \"billable_units\": 4}") and 2026-04-20 ("{\"service_date\": \"2026-04-20\", \"note_title\": \"Physical Therapy\", \"revenue_code\": \"0421\", \"minutes\": 60, \"billable_units\": 4}") demonstrating the level of therapy provided on those days. The per-diem-level extraction shows no level-determination statement for 2026-04-18 and 2026-04-19 ("{\"service_date\": \"2026-04-18\", \"level_determination_statement\": null}" and "{\"service_date\": \"2026-04-19\", \"level_determination_statement\": null}"), and there are no therapy session rows in the flow-sheet for those two dates. Without documented therapy minutes on 2026-04-18 and 2026-04-19, those dates do not support the billed Level 2 Rehab per-diem. Correction: exclude 2026-04-18 and 2026-04-19 from the supported DOS for revenue line 0192. Supported dates (per record) are 2026-04-15-2026-04-17 and 2026-04-20-2026-04-24; the billed Level 2 per-diem is not supported for 2026-04-18 and 2026-04-19. If you believe therapy was provided on 2026-04-18 or 2026-04-19, please provide the contemporaneous therapy notes or flow-sheet entries showing the date/time and minutes by discipline. If additional documentation is not available, those dates will be disallowed at the Level 2 per-diem rate. Sincerely, Clinical Audit Team
